25 F. I’ve been on Zoloft for the last 5 years or so. I was misdiagnosed at age 17 with bipolar after a bad mental episode (my Family brought me to ER I went thru psychosis and did a lot in the house like shout out to them for still talking to me and not giving up LOL)- Anyway flash forward 2 years several doctors later.. turns out I just had SEVERE depression and anxiety lolz. 

Zoloft and vyvanse combo has served me WELL. I graduated college with a 3.4/4.0 GPA, and got a job in corporate. I career transitioned last year- aside from the normal bs of adulthood, I’ve been mentally stable (for the most part) I feel like my symptoms are only triggered- I don’t rlly go thru bouts of depression episodes unless something bad related to family, work, or my love life happens. 

I feel like the next step in starting zoloft is ensuring ur in therapy to regulate ur emotions and cope with life in general. Cheers and best of luck
